items.stem: Country P has five citizens with monthly incomes ₹8,500, ₹14,000, ₹13,500, ₹10,000, ₹9,000. Country Q also has five citizens with monthly incomes ₹500, ₹1,000, ₹1,500, ₹2,000, ₹50,000. Find the average income of each country. In which country would you prefer to live, and why?
items.answer: Both have an average of ₹11,000; Country P, because income is more equally distributed
items.markingKey: Average P = ₹55,000 ÷ 5 = ₹11,000; average Q = ₹55,000 ÷ 5 = ₹11,000 (1 mark each). Averages are equal, but in Q one person earns most of the income while four are very poor, so P is preferable (1 mark). Averages hide disparities.
